arguments.statement: The Resident-authored attention watch for the edge-2026.11.4 registry outcome remained in waiting_evidence after the matching registry Observation was recorded, and no watch Wake was dispatched; the outcome was learned from the user's question instead. Calibration: this attention watch did not by itself produce proactive delivery for a platform-ingested event, so user-facing proactive-notification promises must not assume a watch fires unless an actual Wake is observed.
unknown_items: whether the attention-watch mechanism evaluates Observations ingested by the mechanical release adapter at all
whether a watch Wake would fire for the same event under a different ingestion path
